parse_shell_command: parse a shell command string into a Command AST node with arguments and redirects
lex_shell_string: lex a shell string into tokens including arguments, operators, and redirections
parse_shell_pipeline: parse a shell pipeline string into a Pipeline AST node with multiple commands
parse_shell_expression: parse a full shell expression with operators like && and || into a Seq AST node
lex_shell_quoted_arg: lex a quoted shell argument handling single and double quote escaping rules
